_comment: MTG_EDF_AURA_RANGE (part 2 of the USER-approved EDF cast-order package, 2026-10-14; docs/design/edf-cast-order-2026-10-14.md). Five untapped lands, no outlet; hand Fertile Ground + Peregrine Drake. The pair pays only Drake-first: the Drake taps ahead, refunds five lands, then Fertile Ground ({1}{G}) pays. At its fixed slot the Aura is cast first (2 of 5, +1 bonus = 4 left) and the Drake ({4}{U}) strands, so the enumeration's sequential walk refused the pair every time and CheckLine read the Drake-first line as legal_not_enumerated (base ff3e205b). The range moves a land Aura that costs mana net this turn behind the untappers ONLY when the order is otherwise unpayable (EldraziFlickerProvider::ArrangeCastOrder) -- so the subset is admitted and both apply worlds realise it Drake-first. The probe this came from: build/scratch/castorder/probe_EldraziDisplacerFlicker/aura_drake.json.
